newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North to buy 59.3 pct of Canada's IOCC.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North to buy 59.3 pct of Canada's IOCC.

text.p: Forestry and mining group North Ltd said on Friday it planned to buy a 59.3 percent stake in Iron Ore Co of Canada (IOCC) for US$230 million.
North said the purchase of IOCC shares comprised the combination of Bethlehem Steel Corp's 37.6 percent stake and National Steel Corp's 21.7 percent stake.

The purchase is subject to regulatory and government approvals and the consents of the remaining shareholders, Mitsubishi Corp, which holds 21.8 percent, Dofasco Inc, which holds 6.9 percent, and the Labrador Iron Ore Royalty Income Fund, which holds 12 percent, it said.
North said the purchase is presently expected to be finalised by the end of the first quarter of 1997.
Under the agreement, Bethlehem will receive about US$145 million and National would receive about $85 million, it said.

It said IOCC is Canada's largest iron ore pellet producer selling more than 15 million tonnes per year of blast furnace pellest and concentrates. IOCC operates a mine, concentrator and pellet plant at Carol Lake, in Newfoundland.
IOCC's North American sales will continue to be made under long term contracts primarily with Bethlehem, National Steel and Dofasco at market prices, it said.
"As part of the purchase agreement, the vendors have undertaken to buy additional pellets from IOCC under two significant pellet contracts," North said.
